name: Link
description: Standalone text link atom. Two kinds: action (label-ramp CTA link with chevron) and text (body-md inline link). Matches Figma component set 2609:873 on the ↳ Link page.

props.name: kind
props.description: action = 14px Bold label ramp; text = 16px Regular body-md ramp

props.name: emphasis
props.description: text kind only — subtle uses content/body-subtle

notes: Rendered as a native <a href> — no ARIA needed.
Focus ring is 1px focus-ring/default at 3px offset via :focus-visible.
Per Figma, hover/active states carry no visual change; when the link sits in body copy, set underline=true so color is not the only affordance (WCAG 1.4.1).
Figma's on-light text/default variant has an unbound raw #000 fill; code binds --s2a-color-content-default as the semantic equivalent.
Block padding (6px action / 2px text) is structural — no spacing token rung exists for 6px.
on-light action binds --s2a-color-button-content-primary-solid-inverse exactly as Figma does, even though a content/* token might seem more natural.
